text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Each dot is one Primary's mean quantile score for the arm minus B0's, over all leads and seeds; below zero favours the arm. No interval is drawn. 16 Primary substations; 73 forecast runs, one every 5 days, July 2025 to June 2026.'
text.tspan: Each dot is one Primary's mean quantile score for the arm minus B0's, over all leads and
seeds; below zero favours the arm. No interval is drawn. 16 Primary substations; 73 forecast
runs, one every 5 days, July 2025 to June 2026.
